reason: The retort needs hydrogen to process the iron-rich feedstock, so connecting it seems directly relevant to the goal.
expectation: I expect to connect the retort to the hydrogen supply; it may still need feedstock and power before producing iron.

alternatives.reason: The cable and steel might help build equipment, but their purpose is less clear.

effect: The retort now has solar heat and hydrogen but still needs concentrate.
reaction: The contained exhaust and shared receiver make the setup clearer.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action; it may prepare equipment for processing the feedstock.
expectation: I expect the cable and steel to form some electrical workshop equipment, though its exact purpose is unclear.

effect: The cable and steel made a switchable magnetic separator, providing a way to concentrate the screened feedstock.
reaction: The current-limited supply and switchable release make its operation clear.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action and should separate magnetic grains from the regolith.
expectation: I expect an iron-rich magnetic fraction for the retort, though it may need further processing.

effect: The separator produced the assayed iron-rich concentrate needed by the retort.
reaction: The distinction between magnetic minerals and red colour is useful.
reason: The only offered gameplay action feeds the concentrate into the hydrogen-heated retort.
expectation: I expect hydrogen and heat to reduce the iron-bearing minerals, though the product may need further processing.

effect: The retort reduced the concentrate to porous iron sponge, which needs further processing.
reaction: The explanation of hydrogen removing oxygen makes the transformation clear.
reason: Pressing the sponge is the only offered gameplay action and should make the weak material more usable.
expectation: I expect the press to compact the iron into a denser form, though it may need further treatment.

effect: The heated press consolidated the sponge into a dense billet; the new goal is to shape a process frame.
reaction: The distinction between consolidating the iron and shaping parts is useful.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action and should shape the billet for the frame.
expectation: I expect the press to form the consolidated iron into frame components, though assembly may still be needed.

effect: The billet is now shaped into non-pressure supports for the process frame.
reaction: The distinction from flight hardware makes their intended use clear.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action and should place the supports on the prepared footing.
expectation: I expect to assemble a process frame on the return-plant footing.

effect: The local iron supports now form the gas installation frame, completing the chapter's goals.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the processed regolith become a useful structure, while the precision vessel remains separate.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reducing the concentrate into iron sponge was the most worthwhile moment: it explained hydrogen's role in removing oxygen and led to a tangible local material.

leastWorthwhile.text: Shaping and then placing the frame components felt straightforward and offered little decision-making, although the distinction between shaping and consolidation was useful.

surprise.text: The separator's result clarified that the survey assay, not the regolith's red colour alone, established that it contained suitable iron-bearing minerals.

arbitrary.text: Combining the power cable with steel initially lacked a clear purpose; the resulting electromagnet made sense once explained. It was also the only gameplay action offered at that point.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the locally made frame supports the return-fuel installation and how the preserved discovery gets home, though the largely forced choices make the appeal more educational and narrative than strategic.
